title: TradeMonday Raises Strategic Round from SenseTime for AI Retail Analytics
summary: On June 6, 2023, Hong Kong AI retail big-data startup TradeMonday closed a strategic round from SenseTime Group. Proceeds expand retail analytics products and a ChatGPT B2B retail solution.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / financing · June 14, 2023

On June 6, 2023, Hong Kong AI retail big-data startup TradeMonday closed a strategic round from SenseTime Group. Proceeds expand retail analytics products and a ChatGPT B2B retail solution.

AI low-code modular platform for product, market, and shopper recommendations. Prior backers: Cyberport Hong Kong, XRC Labs, Sente Ventures, Yildiz Holding (seed / angel / Pre-A). Founded 2016 (arbitrage inspiration); graduated Cyberport incubator 2019. Turns social, store traffic, and transaction footprints into actionable profiles for retailers, CPG brands, and malls across food, fashion, beauty, electronics.

New ChatGPT B2B retail analytics: proprietary retail big data + chat queries to cut analysis time and extend into sales consulting. Recognitions from Plug and Play, Founders Space, EY, Alibaba, JumpStarter, RTIA; US/EU/HK VC support. Targeting a larger Series A in 2023.

0 CN images. Author Jiacheng · Review Ski.

— END —
